newsitem.title: GREECE: MICHANIKI SIGNS FINANCING FOR RHODES CASINO.
newsitem.headline: MICHANIKI SIGNS FINANCING FOR RHODES CASINO.

text.p: Rhodes S.A. signed a 4.5 billion drachma syndicated loan for the construction and equipping of the new casino on the island of Rhodes, construction firm Michaniki officials told Reuters.
Michaniki owns 33 percent of Rhodes S.A.

"The 4.5 billion drachma multi-currency non-recourse floating rate loan was signed on February 21. It was granted by Commercial Bank , National Bank and ETEVA," said Akis Drakatos, the CFO of Michaniki.
Commercial Bank was the lead arranger, he added.

Aineias, the venture capital subsidiary of Commercial Bank, owns 33 percent of Rhodes S.A., while the international firm Playboy Incorporated, engaging in entertainment activities, owns 16 percent, he added.
Michaniki plans to reconstruct the old "Hotel of the Rhodes" and transform it into a high-profile casino and provide the necessary machinery and equipment needed for its operation, he said.
"It should be fully operational, with a five star hotel, game rooms and recreation spaces by end-1997," Drakatos added. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
